annotations.title: How long to appeal a denial

description: How long a person has to appeal a health insurance denial, for each plan type or one: employer (ERISA), government employer, Marketplace, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Original Medicare, FEHB. With a plan type and the letter date it returns the exact date; without them it returns the window for every plan type, counted for a letter dated today, each with its regulation. Example questions: how long do I have to appeal an insurance denial; what is the deadline to appeal a Medicare Advantage denial; is it too late to appeal.

letter_date.description: Date printed on the letter, if the reader missed it

plan_type.description: Set only if the letter or the person says so: erisa = Employer plan (private employer, covered by ERISA); gov_employer = Government employer plan (state, county, city or school district); aca_individual = Individual or Marketplace (ACA) plan; medicare_advantage = Medicare Advantage plan; medicaid_managed = Medicaid managed care plan; medicaid_ffs = Medicaid (state agency, no managed care plan); original_medicare = Original Medicare; fehb = Federal employee plan (FEHB)

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say
